articles.summary: EDMONTON, Alberta, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - SNDL Inc. (NASDAQ: SNDL, CSE: SNDL) (“ SNDL ” or the “ Company ”) announced today the renewal of its share repurchase program (the “ Share Repurchase Program ”). Under the Company’s prior Share Repurchase Program, which commenced on November 21, 2025 and completed on November 20, 2026, the Company repurchased an aggregate of 24,488,322 common shares (“ shares ”), representing 10% of the Company’s public float as of the commencement of the prior Share Repurchase Program and 100% of the shares eligible for repurchase. The Share Repurchase Program authorizes the Company to repurchase up to C$100 million (the " Share Repurchase Amount ") of shares from time to time at prevailing market prices, enabling SNDL to opportunistically return value to shareholders. articles.title: SNDL Announces Renewal of Share Repurchase Program
